description: Unit tests for the Orleans.Serialization ArcBufferWriter class, focusing on buffer management, reference counting, page reuse, and boundary conditions within the Orleans serialization system.

classes.name: ArcBufferWriterTests
classes.description: Contains comprehensive unit tests for the ArcBufferWriter class, validating buffer operations, page management, reference counting, boundary conditions, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: MultiPageBuffer_CorrectlyHandlesLargeWritesAndRetrieval
methods.description: Tests writing large data spanning multiple pages and verifies correct data retrieval and buffer slicing.

methods.name: PageBufferManagement_TracksReferenceCountsAndVersions
methods.description: Validates that page reference counts and version numbers are correctly managed during slice consumption and disposal.

methods.name: ReplenishBuffers_ProvidesSegmentsAndFreesPages
methods.description: Ensures buffer replenishment provides correct segments and that pages are freed after use.

methods.name: WriteBuffer_UpdatesLengthCorrectly
methods.description: Checks that writing data updates the buffer length appropriately.

methods.name: PeekSlice_ReturnsCorrectDataWithoutConsuming
methods.description: Verifies peeking at a buffer slice returns correct data without advancing the read position.

methods.name: ConsumeSlice_ReturnsCorrectDataAndUpdatesLength
methods.description: Checks that consuming a slice returns correct data and updates buffer length.

methods.name: UseAfterFree_ThrowsException
methods.description: Ensures that using a slice after unpinning throws an exception.

methods.name: DoubleFree_ThrowsAndBufferCanBeResetAndDisposed
methods.description: Verifies that double unpinning throws and that buffer can be reset and disposed safely.

methods.name: NewBuffer_IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that a new buffer starts empty.

methods.name: WriteEmptyBuffer_DoesNotChangeLength
methods.description: Verifies that writing an empty buffer does not alter buffer length.

methods.name: PeekEmptyBuffer_ReturnsEmptyAndThrowsOnOverflow
methods.description: Ensures peeking at an empty buffer returns empty segments and throws when peeking beyond buffer length.

methods.name: ConsumeEmptyBuffer_ReturnsEmptyAndThrowsOnOverflow
methods.description: Ensures consuming an empty buffer returns empty segments and throws when consuming beyond buffer length.

methods.name: DisposeSliceAfterFullPageConsumption_IncrementsPageVersion
methods.description: Checks that disposing a slice after full page consumption increments page version.

methods.name: PageVersionIncrementAfterWriteAndReadHeadAdvance
methods.description: Verifies page version increments after writing and advancing the read head.

methods.name: DisposedBuffer_ThrowsOnAllOperations
methods.description: Ensures all operations throw ObjectDisposedException after buffer disposal.

methods.name: DoubleDisposeArcBuffer_IsSafe
methods.description: Verifies that double disposing a slice is safe and does not throw.

methods.name: ResetAfterDispose_Throws
methods.description: Checks that resetting a disposed buffer throws ObjectDisposedException.

methods.name: AdvanceWriterNegative_Throws
methods.description: Verifies that advancing the writer by a negative value throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: AdvanceReaderNegativeOrTooLarge_Throws
methods.description: Ensures that advancing the reader by a negative or too-large value throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: ResetReleasesAllPages_EmptiesBuffer
methods.description: Checks that Reset releases all pages and empties the buffer.

methods.name: DisposeMultipleTimes_IsSafe
methods.description: Verifies that multiple disposals are safe and do not throw.

methods.name: WriteAfterDispose_Throws
methods.description: Ensures writing or accessing memory after disposal throws ObjectDisposedException.

methods.name: PinUnpinReferenceCounting_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Validates correct reference counting behavior during pin/unpin operations.

methods.name: UnpinWithInvalidToken_Throws
methods.description: Checks that unpinning with an invalid token throws InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: CheckValidityWithInvalidRefCount_Throws
methods.description: Verifies that invalid reference counts cause CheckValidity to throw.

methods.name: SliceDispose_DoesNotAffectOriginalBuffer
methods.description: Ensures disposing a slice does not affect the original buffer's length.

methods.name: UnsafeSlice_DoesNotPinPages
methods.description: Verifies that UnsafeSlice does not increment page reference counts.

methods.name: CopyToWithInsufficientDestination_Throws
methods.description: Checks that copying to a too-small span throws ArgumentException.

methods.name: ConsumeMoreThanAvailable_Throws
methods.description: Ensures consuming more bytes than available throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: SkipAdvancesReadHead_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies that Skip advances the read head correctly.

methods.name: LargePageReuse_Works
methods.description: Tests that large pages are reused from the pool.

methods.name: MinimumPageReuse_Works
methods.description: Tests that minimum size pages are reused from the pool.

methods.name: BoundaryValue_SlicePeekConsume
methods.description: Checks boundary conditions for slicing, peeking, and consuming at buffer edges.

methods.name: DoubleFree_And_UseAfterFree_Guards
methods.description: Verifies that double free and use-after-free are properly guarded.

methods.name: NoMemoryLeak_ReferenceCountReturnsToZero
methods.description: Ensures that reference counts return to zero after all slices are disposed, preventing memory leaks.

methods.name: EmptyAndFullBuffer_SlicePeek
methods.description: Tests slicing and peeking behavior with empty and full buffers.

methods.name: SliceAtEnd_ReturnsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that slicing at the end of the buffer returns an empty slice.

methods.name: MultipleSlices_SamePage_NoLeak
methods.description: Checks that multiple slices to the same page do not leak memory via reference counts.
